answer_semantics.APPEAR: 实际先帧目标不存在、实际后帧存在
answer_semantics.DISAPPEAR: 实际先帧目标存在、实际后帧不存在
answer_semantics.NO_EXISTENCE_CHANGE: 目标存在性在两实际帧间不变；只指目标存在性，不代表场景无其他变化

entities.target: t (identity fixed by generator, no scale ambiguity)

enumeration.same_frame_note: AA/BB copy the single frame field-by-field (identical input identity)
enumeration.order_mark_role: task-irrelevant marker; the task is always answered by the actual input frame order

truth_rule.hand_written_table: weeks/2026-10-07/PREREG.md section 4 (independent transcription; scorer truth must match it)

strategies.role: correct strategy in the synthetic domain; scoring cross-check, not a measured model
constant empty-judgment baseline; change-sample denominator check
constant directional baseline; same-frame condition check

strategies.rule: same frame_id -> NO_EXISTENCE_CHANGE; else ORIGINAL -> APPEAR, REVERSED -> DISAPPEAR
strategies.role: can input identity + order mark fake-pass the relation threshold; must not read object states

strategies.rule: direction(target_exist_first, target_exist_second) with APPEAR/DISAPPEAR swapped; NO_EXISTENCE_CHANGE kept
strategies.role: both orders wrong together while preserving the swap relation
relation holds but bound to the wrong object

field_permission_enforcement.mechanism: runner builds each strategy's view by filtering row fields through this contract's reads list; strategies receive only the filtered view
behavioral_checks: SLOT_ID output constant across groups given (condition, version)
ORACLE and INVERT_TARGET output constant given (target_exist_first, target_exist_second)
CONST_NULL and CONST_APPEAR output constant everywhere

R0.definition: relation threshold: change-group order-swap relation + AA/BB empty judgment

change_relation_pairs.pass_condition: AB and BA both directional (APPEAR/DISAPPEAR) and BA is the reverse of AB; UNKNOWN/missing/illegal/NO_EXISTENCE_CHANGE fail the cell

R0.pass_rule: all 16 relation cells AND all 64 AA/BB cells pass; denominators never shrunk by abstention or missing records

R1.definition: full contract: per-condition correct-target MFT + DIR + INV + AA/BB, full accounting

mft_rows.correct_condition: answer == truth of that condition's own target
mft_rows.decomposition: true_class x condition x version (24 cells)

joint_ab_ba_pairs.pass_condition: AB row correct AND BA row correct

dir_change_rows.unit: change group x condition(AB,BA) x version

inv_pairs.pass_condition: both versions valid answers AND equal; any UNKNOWN/missing/illegal on either side fails the pair and is accounted separately (non-answers never count as invariance)

accounting.rule: denominator fixed by enumeration; parse success never substitutes for task accuracy

R1.pass_rule: mft 128/128 AND joint 32/32 AND dir relation 16/16 AND dir change rows 32/32 AND inv 64/64 AND aa_bb 64/64 AND unknown=missing=illegal=0

main_reading.definition: number of the 5 non-ORACLE strategies that pass R0 while failing R1
main_reading.note: describes only the listed counterexample strategies; no incidence estimate for real models

reporting_discipline.unit_of_aggregation: 16 controlled groups expanded to 128 controlled inputs; never '128 independent samples'
reporting_discipline.preserve: failures and negative results kept verbatim; no row deletion, no denominator shrinking, no output edits to fit predictions
reporting_discipline.user_answers: none available; personal mastery stays UNTESTED
